refusal.when: A caller asks the fixture-only binary to start ambient capture or to widen its input scope.
refusal.observable: The command exits non-zero with a bounded refusal; no permission prompt, journal write, or network connection occurs.

refusal.when: Consent is absent or revoked, the root cannot be canonicalized, or the source reports an inaccessible scope.
refusal.observable: The collector stays stopped, emits a redacted refusal/gap record, and retains no event from the unauthorized scope.

refusal.when: The entitlement, consent, attribution policy, or privacy evidence is missing.
refusal.observable: No Endpoint Security client is created; the product reports a bounded deferred/no-go result instead of falling back silently.

refusal.when: The wrapper is not explicitly installed and consent is not active.
refusal.observable: No wrapper is installed or spawned, and the refusal contains no command, argument, or environment value.

refusal.when: The repository has not been explicitly selected or its metadata cannot be read safely.
refusal.observable: No Git hook or snapshot is written, and diagnostics contain only a stable refusal code.

refusal.when: The selected frontmost-app capability is unavailable or the user has not consented.
refusal.observable: No Accessibility or screen-recording prompt is triggered; the collector emits a bounded refusal/gap.

refusal.when: The extension/native-host pairing is absent, stale, or the browser reports a private context.
refusal.observable: The message is rejected without retaining a URL/content payload and the refusal reason is stable and redacted.

refusal.when: The selected profile is private, unavailable, or consent has been revoked.
refusal.observable: No profile database is opened and no bookmark value is retained; only the bounded refusal is returned.

refusal.when: Safari has not granted the declared extension permission or the context is private.
refusal.observable: The adapter remains disabled and returns a redacted refusal without requesting broader macOS permissions.

evidence.retention: Keep the run manifest and log digest with the release record; link it from the relevant task and issue.

annual_validation.retirement_rule: Retire a row only after two consecutive release cycles without support, with a dated decision record, migration notice, and an explicit no-go entry replacing the old promise.
